0022600028.text: Utah visits Dallas for a West Group A Emirates NBA Cup game and is the Jazz's 9th game of the season, with Utah sitting at 1-7 (0-3 on the road) and on a six-game losing streak, 14th in the West and 5.5 games back in the Northwest. The Mavericks are 4-4 (2-2 at home), have lost two straight, sit 11th in the West and 2.5 games back in the Southwest. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and their 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the most recent meeting on January 17, 2026 in Dallas, where the Jazz lost 138-120.
